theme.title: NBA Mix 62
theme.subtitle: Five moments from across NBA history
theme.recap: Five NBA stories, five different numbers: a quick tour of stars, teams, records and surprises.

questions.prompt: Devin Booker became the youngest player to score 60 or more, at 20, in a regular-season game. How many points did he score?

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: Devin Booker (70 points; 20 years and 145 days)

funFacts.text: Booker's historic scoring performance came in a loss to Boston rather than a Phoenix victory.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: against the Boston Celtics, Booker became the sixth player in NBA history to score 70 points in a game

funFacts.text: His night was not just shooting: he also supplied eight rebounds and six assists for the Suns.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: Booker also added eight rebounds and six assists in 45 minutes

funFacts.text: Booker's scoring average jumped sharply in his second pro season as his role in Phoenix expanded.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: Booker ended the season averaging 22.1 points per game, a near 9-point increment

questions.prompt: Dwyane Wade was 2006 Finals MVP. What did he average?

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: Averaging 34.7 points per game in the series

funFacts.text: Miami fought back from a two-game deficit to claim the series, rather than winning from the front.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: The Heat overcame a two-games-to-none series deficit to defeat the Mavericks in six games

funFacts.text: Wade scored 36 points in the clinching road victory at Dallas.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: Behind Dwyane Wade's 36 points, Miami rallied from a 14-point first-half deficit

funFacts.text: That Finals victory delivered the first NBA championship in Heat franchise history.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: winning their first NBA championship in franchise history

questions.prompt: The 1987 Lakers lost one game in the West playoffs, when Sleepy Floyd scored how many in Oakland?
questions.context: 1987 West semifinals · Game 4 · Warriors vs Lakers

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: Their only loss was a Sleepy Floyd 51-point outburst in Game 4 in Oakland

funFacts.text: The Lakers swept Denver in the opening round, starting their Western playoff run without a loss.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: they swept the Denver Nuggets in the first round

funFacts.text: Floyd's outburst allowed Golden State to avoid a second-round sweep.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: which allowed the Warriors to avoid a sweep

funFacts.text: Michael Cooper set a playoff mark with six made three-pointers against Boston in the Finals.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: He hit six 3 pointers, a playoff record

questions.prompt: Portland scored how many points in the third quarter of Game 4 of the 1977 Finals?
questions.context: 1977 NBA Finals · Game 4 · vs Philadelphia, at Portland

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: Portland quickly led the game by 17 points and never looked back, scoring 41 points in the third quarter

funFacts.text: Lionel Hollins was Portland's top scorer in Game 4, producing 25 points.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: Pts: Hollins 25

funFacts.text: Walton picked up his fifth foul during the third quarter and spent much of the second half on the bench.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: Walton committing his fifth foul midway through the third and being on the bench

funFacts.text: The lopsided home victory tied the series after Philadelphia had led by two games.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: Series tied, 2–2

questions.prompt: On average, how many million viewers watched Game 7 of the 2010 Finals?

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: Game 7 had the highest average number of viewers with 28.2 million

funFacts.text: ABC's Finals broadcast booth paired Mike Breen with Mark Jackson and Jeff Van Gundy.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: Mike Breen, Mark Jackson and Jeff Van Gundy provided commentary for the games

funFacts.text: Boston starting center Kendrick Perkins sat out the decider after tearing two knee ligaments.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: Perkins tore both his PCL and MCL, and he was ruled out for Game 7

funFacts.text: The deciding contest was the first Finals Game 7 since the Spurs and Pistons reached one in 2005.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: This game was the first Game 7 in an NBA Finals since 2005
